required_transformations: Aggregate daily signup counts by city_tier and signup_date
Aggregate conversion rate using converted_flag grouped by acquisition_channel
Aggregate 7-day retention rate using retained_7d_flag grouped by cohort_week
Do not export any raw user-level data, only provide aggregated results
justification: Aggregate outputs are sufficient to answer all three business questions, making raw data export unnecessary
Following data minimization principle, only minimal internal query fields are allowed
Credential fields (password_hash, auth_token) must never be released externally per policy
Using derived flags (converted_flag, retained_7d_flag) instead of raw timestamps supports the questions while reducing risk
